features.name: Top bar, theme toggle and surface polish
features.notes: Shared top bar on app screens (theme toggle plus a slot for the avatar, which F10 wires to /profile); toggle moves out of the sidebar into the top bar, the practice top bar, and the top-right of the profile picker (login page added in F14 reuses it). Toggle is one switch with sun and moon icons, no visible label, accessible name and state. One elevation token for both themes: update DESIGN-DARK.md first (D24), then tokens.css and every card or surface. Shared hover, pressed and focus states in the button class and tappable cards. Re-run AC12 and AC13 e2e in both themes.

features.name: Profile page
features.notes: Top-bar avatar links to /profile. PATCH /api/v1/me (Zod schema in src/shared; avatar from AVATAR_IDS, name 1-24 chars trimmed) through a profile service; no schema change, the columns exist. Page uses the Settings layout: avatar grid from the built-in set, name field, Save. Top bar, sidebar and picker show the change at once. Duplicate avatars allowed. Leave room for Sign out (F14).

features.name: Practice card: flip, legend and hint
features.notes: Eye icon on Show answer; hint moves outside the card, below the button. 3D flip (CSS transform, perspective, backface-visibility; no new dependency) for button, card tap and Space; reduced motion swaps with no rotation; Undo last returns to the front with no reverse animation. 'How well did you know this?' above the grade buttons. Keep the R12 timing unaffected by the animation (time starts when the front appears). Next-card render must stay under 200 ms (section 16): the flip is for the reveal only.

features.name: Session summary
features.notes: Rebuild SummaryView to the mockup layout: deck card (deck name, or 'Several decks'), ring with cards practised, session time, breakdown chips per grade (icon, label, count), Cards to revisit panel (grade chip, topic, question, count badge), Practise those now (count) and Back to Library. Extend GET /sessions/{id}/summary only if a field is missing (deck name, topic per card). Omit per README items 3, 7 and 20.

features.name: Settings, deck and import fixes
features.notes: T7: drop the On/Off text from Read questions aloud (keep role=switch and aria-checked). T8: Settings preview renders the practice card component from F11 (topic chip, Question label, read-aloud button, footer hint) with sample text. D8: move Delete deck into the Edit deck panel; the D5 confirmation copy is unchanged. I7: ImportFlow becomes one column with sections 1, 2, 3 in order at every width (currently a two-column grid at lg).

features.name: App password gate
features.notes: ADMIN_PASSWORD in env schema (required) and .env.example placeholder. POST /auth/login and /auth/logout, HMAC-signed flipside_auth cookie (node:crypto, timingSafeEqual; key derived from ADMIN_PASSWORD; 30-day constant in src/shared). One access check applied to all pages and /api/v1 except GET /health and POST /auth/login. Login page reuses the profile picker layout and the top-bar theme toggle. Sign out on the Profile page. Every e2e spec signs in through a shared helper; Playwright webServer and launchd app job get ADMIN_PASSWORD; update docs/operations.md. Risk to note in the PR: an iPad home-screen shortcut keeps its own cookies, so it signs in once separately.
